newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police find suspected ETA arms cache.
newsitem.headline: French police find suspected ETA arms cache.

text.p: French police on Monday found a cache of arms belonging to suspected Basque separatist rebels, including guns in a trunk dumped in a river, police sources said.
Para-military gendarmes found the metal trunk, containing several automatic weapons and munitions, in a tributary of the Adour river at Sainte-Marie-de-Gosse in south-west France.
They had earlier found a case containing handguns and bullets on the river bank nearby.
The case was alongside an abandoned van, with two incendiary devices inside, parked on the tow-path.

The sources said ETA separatists, battling the government in neighbouring Spain, might have been trying to hide all the arms and torch the vehicle, which had false licence plates, but for some reason had to abandon the plan.
The Basque separatist group ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) has killed nearly 800 people in a drive for full independence begun in 1968.
